categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in textile dyeing and finishing contract manufacturing and real estate development, specifically residential and commercial building construction and sales. Textile operations involve processing, bleaching, dyeing, and finishing various fiber products, while the real estate segment is managed through a consolidated subsidiary. The textile segment accounts for approximately 43% of consolidated revenue, and real estate accounts for about 56%.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced textile processing technologies including low-foam suppressants in dyeing, low-tension refining machines, beltless fabric wheel dyeing machines for polyester fibers, and physical fabric folding machines to improve surface quality. It integrates digital color management, energy-saving dyeing and setting machines, and AI-assisted fabric inspection systems. The firm also focuses on recycling polyester fiber waste into elastic yarns and developing environmentally friendly yarns, emphasizing sustainable and low-carbon production methods.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include domestic large textile manufacturers, brand owners, trading companies, and overseas garment manufacturers, particularly in the Americas, Europe, and Japan. The company also serves niche markets such as Middle Eastern traditional garments and domestic institutional uniform orders. The textile products are mainly sold to brand and trading customers for export, with over 90% of long-fiber production destined for international markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in Taiwan with its manufacturing base in Taoyuan City, Da-Yuan Industrial Park. Its export markets are mainly in the Americas, Europe, Japan, and emerging Middle Eastern regions. The company also has investment operations in Vietnam, benefiting from regional trade agreements. Taiwan serves as the core production and management hub, while international sales focus on global brand customers.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the textile supply chain, focusing on dyeing and finishing services as a contract manufacturer. It sources chemical raw materials such as dyes and auxiliaries from upstream chemical suppliers and supplies finished textile fabrics to downstream garment manufacturers and brand owners. The company also has downstream involvement through real estate development via subsidiaries.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing high-value, differentiated textile products with functional and environmental features, such as sustainable recycled yarns and high-performance fabrics. The company emphasizes digital transformation, smart manufacturing (Industry 4.0), and innovation in low-carbon and eco-friendly processes. R&D focuses on improving dyeing technologies, developing new functional textiles with moisture-wicking, antibacterial, UV protection, and water-repellent properties, and enhancing product quality and sustainability certifications.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through contract manufacturing services in textile dyeing and finishing, and real estate development and sales. The textile segment earns income by processing fiber products for brand and trading customers, while the real estate segment derives revenue from construction and sale of residential and commercial buildings. The company does not rely on subscription or licensing but on product and service sales.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is one of the few large professional dyeing and finishing manufacturers remaining in Taiwan, competing in a market challenged by regional low-cost producers and vertical integration by fabric and garment manufacturers. It positions itself as a high-quality, service-oriented partner to international brands, leveraging advanced technology and sustainability credentials to differentiate from competitors in Taiwan and the broader Asian textile industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company reported consolidated revenue of approximately NT$643 billion in the latest fiscal year, showing significant growth from the prior year. Net profit attributable to owners was about NT$554 billion, with strong profitability ratios including a return on assets of 17.21% and return on equity of 21.17%. The company has a stable capital base with a total equity of around NT$2.86 billion and continues to invest in capacity upgrades and sustainability initiatives, indicating a positive growth trajectory.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes delivering high-quality, stable, and timely textile dyeing and finishing services tailored to customer needs, focusing on high-value, differentiated, and functional fabrics. It integrates advanced digital color management and smart manufacturing to ensure product consistency and rapid response. Sustainability is a core value, with certifications like Bluesign and OEKO-TEX, and a commitment to low-carbon, eco-friendly production, providing customers with environmentally responsible textile solutions.
